🧼 Product Care Instructions
Trim the wick to 1/4" before each burn to promote a clean, even flame. During the first use, allow the wax to melt evenly across the entire surface to help prevent tunneling. Do not burn the candle for more than 4 hours at a time, and always place it on a heat-resistant surface away from drafts, children, and pets. Never leave a burning candle unattended. Once finished, allow the candle to cool completely before replacing the bamboo lid to help preserve fragrance. Discontinue use when approximately 1/2" of wax remains.
